（印：File No. MUNICIPAL POLICE BR. REGISTRY 3/8 Station 11 Date August 23. 8/46）

Subject (in full) Han Zao Dramatic Society - application for registration

Made by D.S.I. Loh Wei Kong Forwarded by D. S. I. LOGAN.

TSANG MONG TIEN (張蒙天), Chairman
of the Han Zao Dramatic Society, 75 Yifeng Road,
was interviewed at headquarters during the forenoon
of August 23, and informed of the decision of the
D.C. (Special Branch) in respect of the application
of the society for registration. He promised to
wind up the affairs of the society.

（批：H FILE 20/8）

由副督察长罗伟刚呈报 转呈人：副督察长洛根。

汉造剧社主席张蒙天，住怡丰路75号，于8月23日上午在总部接受问询，并获知特别股副总监对该剧社注册申请的决定。他承诺将结束该剧社的事务。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
(印：POLICE File No. TRY 3/8 S.1. Special Br. Station, 140 Date August 21, 1940)

REPORT

Subject Han Zao Dramatic Society - application for registration

Made by D.S.I. Loh Wei Kong Forwarded by: D.S.I. Logan

With reference to the query of D.C. (Special Branch), Tsang Mong Tien (張蒙天), chairman of the Han Zao Dramatic Society has been communicated in respect of the venue to be used for holding meetings or giving performances. He stated that in the event of a meeting being held, the communication address at 75 Tifeng Road will be the venue. In case of rehearsal or the holding of performances, arrangements will be made to use public halls or theatres either in the Settlement or French Concession. The necessary expenses will be borne equally by members of the society and/or defrayed with proceeds from the sale of tickets.

Loh Wei Kong
D. S. I.

D.C. (Special Branch).

（左侧手写批注）：
S.M. Police cannot be a party to this arrangement as we are aware of the opposition of Governor of School.

报告

事由 汉造剧社——注册申请

由副督察长罗伟刚呈报 转呈人：副督察长洛根

关于特别股副总监的查询，已就举行会议或演出的地点问题与汉造剧社主席张蒙天进行沟通。他表示，若举行会议，通讯地址怡丰路75号即为会议地点。若是排练或举行演出，将安排使用公共租界或法租界内的公共礼堂或剧院。所需费用将由剧社成员均摊，和/或由售票收入支付。

罗伟刚
副督察长

特别股副总监。

（左侧手写批注）：
上海公共租界警务处不能成为此安排的一方，因为我们知晓教育局长的反对意见。

application for registration from the Han Zao

society was formed on July 1, 1940 with a
communication address at 75 Tifeng Road. It
is established in the home of Ling Quin Nung
(林昆農), a student of the Shiao Kwang
Middle School, 694 Avenue Joffre, who is one
of the promoters.

The society is in charge of the
following persons with one Tsang Mong Tien as
Chairman :-

(1) Tsang Mong Tien (張家天) alias
Tsang Tseng Ling (張珍麟), student
of the Shiao Kwang Middle School,
residing at 280 Haiphong Road.

(2) Tsang Mong Wen (張家文) alias
Tsang Ning Chih (張銀吉), student
of the Chung Hwa Vocational
School, 1454 Avenue Edward VII.

(3) Ling Quin Nung (林昆農), alias
Ling Shing Kung (林興贛), student
of the Shiao Kwang Middle School,
residing at 75 Tifeng Road.

(4) Miss Loh Ching Yu (陸玉), graduate
of the Shiao Kwang Middle School,
residing at 75 Tifeng Road.

该剧社由以下人员负责，张家天（音译）任主席：-

(5) 李仲琦小姐，效光中学学生，住福煦路四明村104号。

该剧社共有二十四名成员，名单附后。大多数成员为效光中学的在校生及校友。据发起人称，其宗旨为研究戏剧。

在一次问询中，效光中学教员凌祖颐先生表示，根据学校规定，禁止学生在校内创建任何组织。由于汉造剧社是在校外组织的，校方不打算干涉其活动，也不对与该组织有关的学生承担责任。然而，凌先生指出，几名参与剧社的往届生因过往记录不佳，经校方决定已被勒令退学，他对这些学生能否在兼顾学业的同时投身戏剧活动表示怀疑。
